title: Sunrise Remedy Collective
content:
notes:
Lead source: inbound pricing form; free credits requested on 2025-11-02. Primary contact: Emma Lowe (Founder, Clinical Ops).
Discovery call 2025-11-03 with AE Jordan Reyes: goals = hosted API for intake summarization, appointment triage assistant, and embedding-based patient-education doc search. Target latency ~200-400ms for short chat flows; embedding recall for ~50k small documents.
HIPAA-adjacent question: Emma asked 'Do you offer HIPAA / BAA for hosted API?' AE: hosted API is generally not BAA-covered; Private offering can be discussed. Customer is small clinic network (multi-site) and called this 'HIPAA-adjacent' — needs clear guardrails on PHI handling and option for client-side redaction.
Retention and training concerns: wants tokens not stored by default and 30-day max retention with explicit opt-in for training. Asked for written retention policy and how to disable training-on-customer-data.
Security asks: provide SOC2 report, KMS integration for encryption at rest, audit logs for API usage, and SSO/SAML for console access. Shared SOC2 link in drive during call.
POC ask: 2-week sandbox (start proposed 2025-11-15) to validate hosted_api integration with client-side redaction, streaming response for triage flows, and throughput up to 10 req/s with burst handling for appointment windows. Deliverables: integration guide, sample prompt templates, cost projection.
Technical follow-ups for SE (Maya Chen): demo streaming responses, show prefix/KV cache behavior and batching recommendations, provide Node/React SDK snippets and example curl requests. Also show how to tag metadata and retention flags per request.
Commercial: pricing-sensitive SMB. Estimated ARR in the 1k-5k range; wants monthly cost cap and alerts. Interested in Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend (batching, caching).
Blockers summarized: mismatch on HIPAA/BAA expectation, need explicit data retention controls and US-only residency confirmation, budget sign-off dependent on POC outcome.
Next actions: 1) Send hosted_api retention FAQ + SOC2 report link (ACTION: Jordan). 2) Schedule SE tech intro / sandbox provisioning during week of 2025-11-10 (ACTION: Maya). 3) Prepare quickstart with redaction example and sample prompt set.
